Flow Covariate Preparation for Tuolumne

Liz Stebbins

2025-05-05

Pull in flow data for Tuolumne

Historical flows were pulled for the Tuolumne from the USGS gage 11290000 and are processed here to be used in the Tuolumne VA stock-recruit analyses.

Temperature data were pulled and QC’d in /historical-flow-data/Tuolumne/pull_tuolune_gage_data.R

Create flow covariates from historical flows

  • Annual mean of daily mean flow between Jan 1- May 31 (identified from Biological Goals report SR modeling)
  • Flow variation (mean of daily moving 7 day window of weekly max - weekly min flow) for Jan 1 – May 31 (identified from Biological Goals report SR modeling)
